scores.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout and intentional warm/cool color split show some design thinking, but the circle pack is clipped at the bottom of the viewport and the dense dark edge bundles overwhelm the hierarchy they're meant to annotate.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: No magnitude-encoding violations: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing, domains derived from d3.extent(descendantCounts), key functions present on data joins; zero-baseline and line.defined rules are not applicable to this topology layout.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire full 1500ms layout re-transitions on every `input` event without debouncing; the `svg.selectAll('.transitioning').empty()` guard on the tension slider is permanently inert (the class is never applied); and no `.interrupt()` is called on nodeSelection before new transitions begin, leaving stale source/target interpolation state on interrupt.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 200-node circle pack with edge bundles produces a dense tangle of crossing lines through the center that erases any structural signal, and 8 layout modes with flubber shape-morphing transitions across all nodes simultaneously create high animation overhead that cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
